name: Utsushimi Yotsuru
source:
A priest and a prostitute, fallen in love.
Will this love work out?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034397.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一名牧師和一名妓女墜入愛河。
這段愛情能有結果嗎？
